home.heroSubtitle: Building families in love and growing in truth
home.videosSubtitle: Worship through music and let life be lit by love
home.aboutBody: Hallelujah Home Church values family, worship, and truth, building relationships of love, forming mature disciples, and sharing the gospel with more people.

about.historyIntro: From the vision of family altars, the home church has walked step by step into mission, formation, and pastoral care. This timeline preserves key moments as a readable story of life passed on.

vision.intro: The home church vision begins with life multiplying through relationships: one to three, three to twelve, twelve to seventy, and then to the harvest God prepares. Church is not first a building; it is a people who carry witness, formation, and blessing wherever they go.

sections.title: Unity and Mission
sections.body: Home Church is built to bring people into unity with God and one another in Christ, and to carry God's love outward as a blessing to the people around us.

sections.title: Mission for Chinese communities, Chinese communities for mission
sections.body: The vision reaches Chinese-speaking communities wherever they are, not as a political or geographic idea, but as a call to carry the gospel with shared heritage, responsibility, and love.

sections.title: Shared life, love and equipping, anointing passed on

cards.title: Shared life
cards.body: A community where people can be honest, received, supported, and built together as the body of Christ.

cards.title: Love and equipping
cards.body: Building one another in love and helping each saint serve from the right place.

cards.title: Anointing passed on
cards.body: Every person is formed by spiritual parents and learns to raise spiritual children for the mission entrusted by God.

sections.title: Mission, Spirit-filled theology, team ministry, discipleship

cards.title: Mission-led
cards.body: Formation serves mission, equipping people to live as spiritual parents and as salt and light.

cards.title: Spirit-filled theology
cards.body: God's word is lived and experienced as people are filled by the Spirit day by day.

cards.title: Team ministry
cards.body: The church is the body of Christ, where gifts and callings become visible through service and connection.

cards.title: Discipleship
cards.body: Disciples follow pastors, pastors follow Paul, and Paul follows Christ, so formation can continue across generations.

lines: Listen to me, you islands; hear this, you distant nations: Before I was born the Lord called me; from my mother’s womb he has spoken my name. He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver. He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor.”

And now the Lord says— he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the Lord and my God has been my strength— he says: “It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.”

privacyPolicy.intro: Welcome to the Hallelujah Home Church website (this website). To help you use the services and information on this website with confidence, this Privacy Policy explains how this website protects your rights and handles personal information. Please read the following terms carefully.

sections.title: Scope and data controller
body: This policy applies to the public pages and online services provided by this website. This website is provided and maintained by Hallelujah Community Care Association, R.O.C.
If this website links to third-party websites, video platforms, social platforms, or map services, those services are governed by their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Information we may collect
body: When you contact us through a form, email, or event registration, we may collect your name, contact details, registration details, message content, and other information needed to respond to your request.

When you browse this website, servers or third-party services may generate necessary technical data, such as IP address, browser information, device type, access time, browsing and click records, and error logs.

sections.title: How we use information
body: We use information only as needed for church administration, event communication, pastoral care, responding to inquiries, website operations, security, and service improvement.
Browsing and click records are mainly used for internal analysis of traffic, content quality, and service experience, not to identify specific individuals for advertising tracking.
We do not sell your personal information or provide it to unrelated third parties for marketing unless required by law, needed to protect rights, or authorized by your consent.

sections.title: Retention period, region, recipients, and methods
body: We use information during the period needed for the collection purpose, legal requirements, or church administrative record retention.

The region of use is limited to where this website, church administration, and service providers operate. Recipients may include the association, entrusted service providers, and authorities legally entitled to request information.
Methods of use may include electronic processing, manual contact, event administration, website operations, security management, statistical analysis, and other necessary methods permitted by law.

sections.title: Vendors and third-party services
body: To provide hosting, forms, email, video, maps, or security maintenance, we may engage service providers to process information within the necessary scope.

We require service providers to keep information confidential, use appropriate security measures, and process information only for the entrusted purpose. We may provide necessary information when required by law, judicial or competent authorities, rights protection, or harm prevention.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This website may use necessary cookies to remember your language preference, such as hhc_locale. These cookies provide website functions you request and are not used for advertising tracking.
You can refuse or delete cookies through your browser settings, but some language preferences or website functions may not be saved correctly.
If we later add analytics, advertising, or other non-essential tracking tools, we will update this policy and provide any required choice or consent mechanism under applicable law.

sections.title: Retention and protection
body: We retain information only for as long as needed to fulfill the collection purpose, meet legal obligations, or maintain church administrative records.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information. No internet transmission is completely secure, so please avoid submitting unnecessary sensitive information through public forms.

sections.title: Your rights and contact
body: You may request access, copies, correction, supplementation, deletion, or the suspension of collection, processing, or use of your personal information as allowed by applicable law.
If you do not provide necessary information, we may be unable to respond to inquiries, complete event registration, provide related services, or save your language preference.
If you have questions about this policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us through the church contact information provided on this website.

termsOfUse.intro: By using this website, you agree to these terms. This website mainly provides church information, service content, weekly paper downloads, and related resources.

sections.title: Website content
body: The content on this website is provided for general information, faith formation, and church ministry use. We try to keep information accurate, but event times, locations, downloads, and external links may change.
If website information differs from official church announcements, the latest church announcement or response from the church contact window should prevail.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: Unless otherwise stated, text, images, design, weekly papers, media, and other content on this website are owned by Hallelujah Community Care Association, R.O.C. or the relevant rights holders.

You may read, download, and share public content for personal, family, or non-commercial church use. Without permission, you may not use content commercially, create derivative works, sublicense it, or remove rights notices.

sections.title: Use restrictions
body: You may not use this website in a way that interferes with its operation, attempts unauthorized access, distributes malicious code, impersonates others, or violates applicable law.
If you submit messages, registration details, or other content, you are responsible for making sure it is accurate, lawful, and does not infringe the rights of others.

sections.title: Third-party services and links
body: This website may link to YouTube, Facebook, maps, or other third-party services. Those services are governed by their own terms and policies, and this website does not control their content or data handling.
Before using third-party services, you should review their terms, privacy policies, and security settings.

sections.title: Disclaimer
body: The content on this website is not legal, medical, financial, or other professional advice. If you need professional help, please seek advice from a qualified professional.

We will make reasonable efforts to handle service interruptions or delays caused by network issues, maintenance, third-party service failures, or force majeure, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted website availability.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms based on website services, legal requirements, or church ministry needs. Updated terms will be posted on this page and take effect when posted.
If you continue using this website after the terms are updated, you are deemed to agree to the updated terms.
